name: Date
selection: Two different fruits share the name. Cured dates — the packaged Medjools sold year-round — should be plump with a slight sheen; sugar crystals on the surface are harmless but mean age. Fresh dates are a late-summer farmers-market find: yellow Barhi in the crunchy khalal stage are crisp and faintly astringent, while softer brown rutab dates are sweeter and melt in the mouth.
storage: Cured dates keep for months airtight at room temperature, or refrigerate to keep them soft. Fresh khalal and rutab dates are perishable and should be refrigerated and eaten within a week.
